cards.name: IImpactToolDS
cards.summary: Data source behind the property bar of the Impact tool (Toolbox/Shape Tools/Impact tool), which draws comic-style radial bursts or parallel speed lines between an inner and an outer boundary. It exposes the effect type, stroke type, line spacing and width ranges (with randomisation), angle and taper position of the selected impact effect.
use_for: comic burst or manga focus lines behind a headline or product
speed lines on a sale / launch poster
making many impact effects share the same spacing, width and stroke settings in a batch script
avoid: creating the effect: this interface has no create call, the effect is drawn interactively with the Impact tool
static line patterns that never change: a plain blend or contour of lines is easier to script through VGCore
cards.how: Back end of the Impact tool property bar (ImpactToolLib, dual dispinterface). Reached at run time through the UI framework, not the document model: Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext.GetDataSource(<registered name>) returns an ICUIDataSourceProxy; read and write this interface's members by name with proxy.GetProperty("Name") / proxy.SetProperty "Name", value and run its methods with proxy.InvokeMethod "Name". DrawUI.xml binds the Impact tool property bar controls to DataSource=ImpactToolDS, so "ImpactToolDS" is the name to pass to GetDataSource (the live call is unverified; the source may only exist once that UI has been opened). Values act on the impact shape that is selected while the Impact tool is active (IsToolShapeSelected). Activate the tool first with FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem "874d2621-3a80-96b4-436e-e9f11b74bf02" (the Impact tool GUID in the cdr_tool harvest).

key_members.name: IsToolShapeSelected
key_members.use: True when an impact effect is selected; check it before writing any value

key_members.name: EffectTypes
key_members.use: read-only list of effect type names (radial / parallel style choices)

key_members.name: EffectType
key_members.use: current effect type; set to one of the names in EffectTypes

key_members.name: StrokeTypeItems
key_members.use: read-only list of stroke shapes for the lines

key_members.name: StrokeType
key_members.use: current stroke type; set to one of the names in StrokeTypeItems

key_members.name: SpacingMin
key_members.use: smallest gap between lines

key_members.name: SpacingMax
key_members.use: largest gap between lines

key_members.name: SpacingMinLowerRange
key_members.use: lowest value SpacingMin accepts (pair with SpacingMinUpperRange)

key_members.name: SpacingSteps
key_members.use: number of spacing steps between min and max

key_members.name: SpacingRandomized
key_members.use: randomise spacing between min and max

key_members.name: WidthMin
key_members.use: thinnest line width

key_members.name: WidthMax
key_members.use: thickest line width

key_members.name: WidthRandomized
key_members.use: randomise line widths between min and max

key_members.name: RandomizeStartPoints
key_members.use: jitter where lines start (ragged inner edge)

key_members.name: RandomizeEndPoints
key_members.use: jitter where lines end; only when RandomEndPointsSupported is True

key_members.name: AngleDegrees
key_members.use: line angle, used by the parallel-line effect type

key_members.name: ThickestPointPosPercent
key_members.use: where along each line it is thickest (taper position); only when ThicknessPointEnabled

key_members.name: ActiveBoundarySelectorTool
key_members.use: which boundary picker (inner / outer shape) is active

key_members.name: SpacingUnit
key_members.use: unit code the spacing values are shown in

gotchas: It is a UI data source, not a document object: there is no Shape-level route to it in VGCore, and nothing in the harvested object model returns IImpactToolDS.
Read the *LowerRange / *UpperRange members before setting SpacingMin/Max or WidthMin/Max; what happens to an out-of-range value (clamp or error) is not known (unverified).
EffectTypes and StrokeTypeItems are single strings; the delimiter of the list is not harvested, so print them once before parsing (unverified).

Units: DrawUI.xml feeds the spacing and width spinners internalUnit = SpacingInternalUnit / WidthInternalUnit and displayUnit = SpacingUnit / WidthUnit, so the values you get and set are in the internal unit, not the document unit; convert before writing.
With no impact shape selected, writes probably only change the tool's defaults for the next effect drawn (unverified).
cards.example:
Set ds = Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext.GetDataSource("ImpactToolDS")
If ds.GetProperty("IsToolShapeSelected") Then
  Debug.Print ds.GetProperty("EffectTypes"), ds.GetProperty("SpacingMinLowerRange")
  ds.SetProperty "SpacingRandomized", True
  ds.SetProperty "WidthRandomized", True
End If

review.changes: named the data source ImpactToolDS (DrawUI.xml binding) in how + example and added the tool GUID from the cdr_tool harvest; units gotcha now states what DrawUI.xml shows (values travel in the internal unit) instead of a guess

cards.name: IDocumentItem
cards.summary: One entry of CorelDRAW's most-recently-used document list (MruListLib): the file's path, name and folder, paths to its preview and thumbnail images, last-modified date and size in bytes. Read-only; which UI it serves is not harvested (probably the Welcome screen's recent files).
use_for: building a recent-work picker or contact sheet from the thumbnail / preview paths
finding the last-edited client file to reopen in an automated session
avoid: reopening or editing the recent list from a script: use Application.RecentFiles (VGCore IVGRecentFiles has Add, Item, Count and Maximum; each IVGRecentFile has Open and Delete)
cards.how: Item of an IDocumentItems collection (IDocumentItems.Item(Index)). Nothing in the harvested VGCore model returns IDocumentItems, and DrawUI.xml binds no control to MruListLib (the Welcome screen's WWelcomeScreenDataSource exposes no recent-file member), so the route to it is not known (possibly used internally by the HTML Welcome screen; unverified). For ordinary scripts the documented recent list is Application.RecentFiles.

key_members.name: DocumentPath
key_members.use: full path of the document file

key_members.name: DocumentName
key_members.use: document name

key_members.name: DocumentFolder
key_members.use: folder the document is in

key_members.name: PreviewPath
key_members.use: path to a larger preview image of the document

key_members.name: ThumbnailPath
key_members.use: path to the thumbnail image shown in the gallery

key_members.name: Date
key_members.use: last-modified date (COM DATE)

key_members.name: DateAsString
key_members.use: last-modified date formatted with a Format string

key_members.name: Size
key_members.use: document size in bytes

gotchas: All properties are read-only; there is no Open or Delete here (those live on VGCore IVGRecentFile).
The Format syntax DateAsString expects is not harvested (unverified); Date returns a COM DATE you can format yourself.
PreviewPath / ThumbnailPath point at cache files that may be missing for files saved by older versions or on other machines (unverified).
cards.example:
' items: an IDocumentItems collection (route not harvested)
For Each d In items
  Debug.Print d.DocumentName, d.DocumentFolder, d.Size, d.Date
  thumb = d.ThumbnailPath
Next

review.changes: avoid no longer puts Add on IVGRecentFile (it is on IVGRecentFiles); how/summary now say DrawUI.xml and the Welcome screen data source show no route instead of asserting the Welcome screen hands it out

cards.name: IDocumentItems
cards.summary: Collection of IDocumentItem entries: CorelDRAW's most-recently-used document list as kept by MruListLib (which UI uses it is not harvested). Read-only: count, indexed item and For Each enumeration.
use_for: listing recent design files with their thumbnails for a launcher or report
avoid: adding, removing or opening recent files: use Application.RecentFiles (VGCore IVGRecentFiles: Add, Item, Count, Maximum)
cards.how: Collection interface of MruListLib. Nothing in the harvested VGCore model returns IDocumentItems, and DrawUI.xml binds no control to MruListLib (the Welcome screen's WWelcomeScreenDataSource exposes no recent-file member), so the route to it is not known (possibly used internally by the HTML Welcome screen; unverified). Iterate with For Each (_NewEnum) or Item(Index) up to Count.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of documents in the list

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: the IDocumentItem at Index

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: enumerator behind For Each

gotchas: Whether Item is 1-based like the VGCore collections is not harvested (unverified); For Each avoids the question.
This is a snapshot list for display; it may not match Application.RecentFiles exactly (unverified).
cards.example:
' items: an IDocumentItems collection
For i = 1 To items.Count   ' base not harvested; For Each is safer
  Debug.Print items.Item(i).DocumentPath
Next

review.changes: how/summary: dropped the unsupported 'via the Welcome screen data source' route; DrawUI.xml shows no binding

cards.name: IPerspectiveGroupProperties
cards.summary: Settings object of a perspective group (Object/Perspective/Draw in Perspective): the viewport rectangle, colour, opacity, density and visibility of the perspective and horizon lines, the lock flag, and the horizon, vanishing and camera points that define the grid. It is a detached copy: edit it, then write it back to the group.
use_for: setting up a one-, two- or three-point perspective grid for packaging, signage or room mock-ups by script
hiding or dimming the perspective guides before export
copying one group's vanishing points to another so several scenes share a camera
avoid: distorting an existing object into perspective: that is the Add Perspective effect (VGCore IVGEffectPerspective)
cards.how: Obtained with IPerspectiveGroupShape.GetPropertiesCopy() on a perspective group (Shape.Custom of the group). Change properties or call the Set*Points methods on the copy, then apply it with IPerspectiveGroupShape.CopyAssignProperties(props). Points travel as VGCore IVGPointRange; planes are cdrPerspPlane values (cdrPerspPlaneNone 0, cdrPerspPlaneOrtho 1, cdrPerspPlaneTop 2, cdrPerspPlaneLeft 3, cdrPerspPlaneRight 4 in the VGCore harvest).

key_members.name: Viewport
key_members.use: IVGRect area the perspective grid covers

key_members.name: ShowPerspectiveLines
key_members.use: show / hide the perspective guide lines

key_members.name: ShowHorizonLines
key_members.use: show / hide the horizon line

key_members.name: PerspectiveLineColor
key_members.use: IVGColor of the perspective lines

key_members.name: HorizonLineColor
key_members.use: IVGColor of the horizon lines

key_members.name: PerspectiveLineOpacity
key_members.use: opacity of the perspective lines

key_members.name: HorizonLineOpacity
key_members.use: opacity of the horizon line

key_members.name: LineDensity
key_members.use: density percentage of the guide lines

key_members.name: Locked
key_members.use: lock flag of the perspective group (typelib: 'the locked property')

key_members.name: GetHorizonPointsCopy
key_members.use: copy of the horizon points (IVGPointRange)

key_members.name: SetHorizonPoints
key_members.use: replace the horizon points

key_members.name: GetVanishPointsCopy
key_members.use: copy of the vanishing points of one plane

key_members.name: SetVanishPoints
key_members.use: replace the vanishing points of one plane

key_members.name: GetCameraPointsCopy
key_members.use: copy of the camera points of one plane and camera index

key_members.name: SetCameraPoints
key_members.use: replace the camera points of one plane and camera index

gotchas: Everything is a copy: changing this object or a point range from Get*Copy does nothing until CopyAssignProperties is called on the group.
Editing a colour in place (props.PerspectiveLineColor.RGBAssign ...) may change a temporary copy only; assign a whole IVGColor instead (unverified).
The scale of the opacity values (0-1 or 0-100) and the valid LineDensity range are not harvested (unverified); read the current values first.
What CameraIndex counts (one camera point set per plane, or several) is not documented in the typelib; read GetCameraPointsCopy before writing (unverified).
cards.example:
Set pg = ActiveShape.Custom          ' a perspective group
Set p = pg.GetPropertiesCopy()
p.ShowPerspectiveLines = False
p.ShowHorizonLines = False
p.Locked = True
pg.CopyAssignProperties p

review.changes: listed the harvested cdrPerspPlane values; Locked no longer claims 'cannot be dragged' (typelib only says locked property)

cards.name: IPerspectiveGroupShape
cards.summary: A perspective group: the custom shape created by Object/Perspective/Draw in Perspective, holding a one-, two- or three-point perspective grid that objects drawn inside it are projected onto. Scripts use it to enter or leave perspective edit mode, read the active plane, and get or set the grid's properties.
use_for: scripted packaging, storefront or interior mock-ups drawn in perspective
switching a perspective group into edit mode before adding artwork to a plane
reading or replacing the grid setup of an existing perspective drawing
avoid: bending a single finished object into perspective: use the Add Perspective effect (Object/Perspective/Add Perspective)
cards.how: Inherits IVGCustomShape. Reach it with Shape.Custom on the group shape (its Shape.Type is cdrCustomShape = 21; TypeID tells which custom shape it is). Settings go through GetPropertiesCopy / CopyAssignProperties with an IPerspectiveGroupProperties object. EnterEditMode is the scripted counterpart of Object/Perspective/Edit Perspective Group (cdr_menu 70453c54-f634-4aca-9577-204f48008e7e) (unverified that they match exactly).

key_members.name: TypeID
key_members.use: identifies the custom shape type (check it before assuming a perspective group)

key_members.name: ActivePlane
key_members.use: the plane (cdrPerspPlane) new drawing goes onto

key_members.name: EnterEditMode
key_members.use: enter perspective edit mode for this group

key_members.name: LeaveEditMode
key_members.use: leave perspective edit mode

key_members.name: GetPropertiesCopy
key_members.use: detached IPerspectiveGroupProperties with the grid settings

key_members.name: CopyAssignProperties
key_members.use: apply an edited IPerspectiveGroupProperties to the group

gotchas: ActivePlane is read-only and this interface has no setter for the plane, so a script cannot switch planes through it.
Always pair EnterEditMode with LeaveEditMode; a script that stops in between leaves the document in perspective edit mode (unverified).
The exact TypeID string of a perspective group is not harvested; read it from a known group before filtering on it.
Shape.Custom returns IVGCustomShape; late-bound callers (VBA Object, win32com dynamic) can call these members directly, early-bound code needs a cast (unverified).

Grid presets (One-point, Two-point, Three-point worm's-eye / bird's-eye) are not on this interface: they are the Perspective tool property-bar list PerspectiveGroupToolDS.PresetList (cdr_preset harvest).
cards.example:
Set s = ActiveShape
Set pg = s.Custom
Debug.Print pg.TypeID, pg.ActivePlane
pg.EnterEditMode
' ... draw on the active plane ...
pg.LeaveEditMode

review.changes: named the harvested shape type cdrCustomShape (21) and the Edit Perspective Group menu GUID; added a gotcha pointing presets to PerspectiveGroupToolDS.PresetList

cards.name: IPhotoCocktailDataSource
cards.summary: Data source behind the PhotoCocktail docker (Effects/PhotoCocktail), which rebuilds the selected object (typically a photo) as a photo mosaic made of many small photos taken from a chosen folder (the image pool). It exposes the pool, output mode, tile grid density and size, output size and dpi, duplicate rules, blending amount, quality and edge handling, and the Apply / Cancel actions.
use_for: photo-mosaic portraits or logos built from event or product photos
community / fan-wall posters where one big image is made of many submitted pictures
avoid: simple pixelation or square tiles: a bitmap effect is faster than indexing a photo pool
unattended runs: choosing the pool opens a folder dialog (see gotchas)
cards.how: Back end of the PhotoCocktail docker (PhotoCocktailLib, dual dispinterface). Reached at run time through the UI framework, not the document model: Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext.GetDataSource(<registered name>) returns an ICUIDataSourceProxy; read and write this interface's members by name with proxy.GetProperty("Name") / proxy.SetProperty "Name", value and run its methods with proxy.InvokeMethod "Name". DrawUI.xml binds the PhotoCocktail docker (Apply button = OnApply / ApplyButtonEnabled, pool button = OnSelectImagePool) controls to DataSource=PhotoCocktailDS, so "PhotoCocktailDS" is the name to pass to GetDataSource (the live call is unverified; the source may only exist once that UI has been opened). Needs a selected source object and an indexed image pool before Apply is enabled. Open the docker first: Effects/PhotoCocktail, FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem "03687a21-eb94-d8a8-4fe6-a2c8b5251210" (cdr_effect harvest; the item toggles the docker).

key_members.name: OnSelectImagePool
key_members.use: choose the folder of photos to build the mosaic from

key_members.name: PoolDirectory
key_members.use: read-only: folder currently used as the image pool

key_members.name: IndexedImageCount
key_members.use: how many pool images are indexed

key_members.name: SelectionInfo
key_members.use: what is selected as the mosaic source

key_members.name: OutputModes
key_members.use: read-only list of output modes

key_members.name: OutputMode
key_members.use: chosen output mode (one of OutputModes)

key_members.name: NumBlocksInWidth
key_members.use: tiles across the width (mosaic density)

key_members.name: RequestedOutputBlockSizeInPixels
key_members.use: size of each tile in pixels

key_members.name: RequestedOutputWidthInPixels
key_members.use: width of the finished mosaic in pixels

key_members.name: RequestedDpi
key_members.use: resolution of the result

key_members.name: AllowDuplicates
key_members.use: let the same photo appear more than once

key_members.name: RequestedDuplicateExclusionRadius
key_members.use: minimum distance before a photo may repeat

key_members.name: BlendingAmount
key_members.use: how much the source colours are blended over the tiles

key_members.name: QualityMode
key_members.use: matching quality (one of QualityModes)

key_members.name: EdgeHandlingMode
key_members.use: how tiles at the edges are handled (one of EdgeHandlingModes)

key_members.name: KeepOriginal
key_members.use: keep the source object after applying

key_members.name: ApplyButtonEnabled
key_members.use: True once source and pool are ready

key_members.name: OnApply
key_members.use: build the mosaic

key_members.name: OperationProgress
key_members.use: progress of the running build

key_members.name: OnCancel
key_members.use: cancel the build

gotchas: PoolDirectory is read-only; the only harvested way to set the pool is OnSelectImagePool, which most likely opens a modal folder picker and hangs an unattended COM call (unverified).
OnApply on a large pool runs long; poll OperationProgress / StatusText instead of assuming the call blocks until done (unverified).
OutputModes, QualityModes and EdgeHandlingModes are single strings listing the choices; print them before setting the matching *Mode (delimiter not harvested).
ForceCustomDPI, ForceTileSize and ForceMosaicSize are read-only flags: when True the matching Requested* value is presumably fixed by the output mode (unverified).
cards.example:
Set ds = Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext.GetDataSource("PhotoCocktailDS")
Debug.Print ds.GetProperty("PoolDirectory"), ds.GetProperty("IndexedImageCount")
ds.SetProperty "NumBlocksInWidth", 60
ds.SetProperty "AllowDuplicates", False
ds.SetProperty "KeepOriginal", True
If ds.GetProperty("ApplyButtonEnabled") Then ds.InvokeMethod "OnApply"

review.changes: named the data source PhotoCocktailDS (DrawUI.xml binding) in how + example; added the docker's menu GUID from the cdr_effect harvest

cards.name: IProjectTimerDataSource
cards.summary: Data source behind CorelDRAW's Project Timer (DrawUI.xml: a ProjectTimer toolbar whose drop-down opens the task-log popup), which logs time spent on a document as named, tagged tasks, detects inactivity, and exports the log as CSV or text. Most members are the toolbar's and popup's labels, tooltips and button handlers; the useful ones start / pause tracking, create and rename tasks and export the log.
use_for: billing clients by design file: export a per-task time log
pausing time tracking while a batch script runs so automated work is not billed
tagging tasks (concept, revisions, print prep) for a timesheet
avoid: building documents or artwork: nothing here touches the drawing
unattended export to a chosen path: ExportToCSV / ExportToTXT take no path (see gotchas)
cards.how: Back end of the Project Timer toolbar and its task-log popup (ProjectTimerLib, dual dispinterface). Reached at run time through the UI framework, not the document model: Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext.GetDataSource(<registered name>) returns an ICUIDataSourceProxy; read and write this interface's members by name with proxy.GetProperty("Name") / proxy.SetProperty "Name", value and run its methods with proxy.InvokeMethod "Name". DrawUI.xml binds the Project Timer toolbar and popup controls to DataSource=ProjectTimerDS, so "ProjectTimerDS" is the name to pass to GetDataSource (the live call is unverified; the source may only exist once that UI has been opened). Edits follow the popup's two-step pattern: set the edit field (NameEdit, TagEdit, DurationHour ...) then invoke the matching ...Ok handler (in DrawUI.xml the TagEdit box commits with TagEditOk, the NameEdit box with NameEditEnter); which row is edited presumably follows TaskLogListCurSel (unverified).

key_members.name: Track
key_members.use: tracking on / off

key_members.name: UpdateCurrentTrackState
key_members.use: refresh the current tracking state

key_members.name: CurrentTaskName
key_members.use: name of the task being timed

key_members.name: CurrentTaskElapsedTime
key_members.use: elapsed time of the current task (display string)

key_members.name: CurrentTaskState
key_members.use: state of the current task (display string)

key_members.name: CurrentTaskTags
key_members.use: tags of the current task

key_members.name: TotalStatus
key_members.use: total tracked time summary

key_members.name: WorkBlockList
key_members.use: read-only list of logged work blocks

key_members.name: CreateNewTask
key_members.use: start a new task in the log

key_members.name: NameEdit
key_members.use: edit buffer for a task name; commit with NameEditOk

key_members.name: NameEditOk
key_members.use: commit NameEdit

key_members.name: TagEdit
key_members.use: edit buffer for task tags; commit with TagEditOk

key_members.name: TagEditOk
key_members.use: commit TagEdit

key_members.name: OnResumeTask
key_members.use: resume the selected task

key_members.name: ExportToCSV
key_members.use: export the task log as CSV

key_members.name: ExportToTXT
key_members.use: export the task log as plain text

key_members.name: UserInactivityDetectionMode
key_members.use: inactivity handling (one of UserInactivityDetectionModeList)

key_members.name: SettingsPauseTrackingOnAnotherDocumentOpen
key_members.use: pause when another document is opened

key_members.name: ShowDeletedTask
key_members.use: show deleted tasks in the log

gotchas: ExportToCSV and ExportToTXT take no path, so they most likely open a Save dialog: a modal dialog that blocks an unattended COM call (unverified).

Many members are UI strings (tooltips such as RecordPauseTT, labels such as InactivityPromptLabel2) and dialog show/hide handlers; calling On...Show/Hide from a script drives the toolbar / popup UI, not the data.
One member is spelled ShowDeletedTaslVisible in the typelib (sic); use the exact harvested spelling.
The inactivity prompt (OnInactivityPrompt...) can appear during long scripts; set UserInactivityDetectionMode before a batch run (unverified).
DrawUI.xml enables the toolbar's task drop-down only while a document is open (AppDS DocumentAvailable); open or create a document before driving it.
cards.example:
Set ds = Application.FrameWork.Application.DataContext.GetDataSource("ProjectTimerDS")
ds.SetProperty "Track", False          ' pause while the batch runs
' ... automated work ...
ds.SetProperty "Track", True
ds.InvokeMethod "UpdateCurrentTrackState"
Debug.Print ds.GetProperty("CurrentTaskName"), ds.GetProperty("TotalStatus")

review.changes: 'Project Timer docker' was wrong: DrawUI.xml defines it as a ProjectTimer toolbar with a drop-down popup; fixed summary/how/gotcha, named the data source ProjectTimerDS in how + example, corrected the edit-commit handlers from DrawUI.xml, added the document-open gotcha

cards.name: ITableBorders
cards.summary: The border outlines of a table, a cell or a cell range: one IVGOutline per side (top, left, right, bottom), the inner horizontal and vertical lines, combined sets and all borders at once, plus SetBorders to copy one outline onto any chosen set of borders.
use_for: price lists and spec tables with hairline inner rules and a heavier outer frame
removing all borders for a clean, borderless table layout
styling just the header row's bottom rule
avoid: cell background colour: that is ITableCell.Fill or ITableCellRange.ApplyFill
cards.how: Returned by ITableShape.Borders (whole table), ITableCell.Borders (one cell) and ITableCellRange.Borders (a range). Each side property returns a VGCore IVGOutline; BorderKind arguments take cdrTableBorder flags (VGCore harvest): Left 1, Top 2, Right 4, Bottom 8, Horizontal 16, Vertical 32, plus the combined members Outside 15, Inside 48 and All 63; AreIdentical's BorderKind defaults to 63 (all).

key_members.name: Top
key_members.use: outline of the top border

key_members.name: Bottom
key_members.use: outline of the bottom border

key_members.name: Left
key_members.use: outline of the left border

key_members.name: Right
key_members.use: outline of the right border

key_members.name: Horizontal
key_members.use: outline of the inner horizontal borders

key_members.name: Vertical
key_members.use: outline of the inner vertical borders

key_members.name: All
key_members.use: outline properties of all borders together

key_members.name: Combined
key_members.use: outline properties of the set of borders named by a cdrTableBorder value

key_members.name: AreIdentical
key_members.use: True when the given borders share the same outline

key_members.name: SetBorders
key_members.use: copy an IVGOutline onto the borders named by a cdrTableBorder value

gotchas: The side properties are read-only object references; whether setting .Width / .Color on the returned IVGOutline writes back to the table is not confirmed (unverified). SetBorders is the explicit write path.
BorderKind values are bit flags; use the named members (cdrTableBorderOutside, cdrTableBorderInside, cdrTableBorderAll ...) rather than hand-made sums.
Outline widths are in document units like the rest of the VGCore model (unverified for the table component).
With SeparatedBorders = False on the table, neighbouring cells share one border line, so a cell's Right and the next cell's Left are the same line (unverified).
cards.example:
Set t = ActiveShape.Custom             ' a table
Set b = t.Borders
Debug.Print b.Top.Width, b.Horizontal.Width
b.SetBorders cdrTableBorderInside, b.Top   ' inner lines copy the top outline
Set h = t.Rows.First.Cells.All.Borders
Debug.Print h.Bottom.Width

review.changes: example called SetBorders with an undefined variable 'kind' (would pass Empty); now uses cdrTableBorderInside; how lists the harvested cdrTableBorder values and the AreIdentical default 63

cards.name: ITableCell
cards.summary: One cell of a CorelDRAW table: its row and column, size, merge state, fill, borders, text margins, the text shape that holds its text and any shapes placed inside it, plus methods to select, split, unmerge, set margins and place shapes in the cell.
use_for: filling a price list or timetable cell by cell from data
dropping logos or icons into cells with PlaceShape (centred)
colouring alternate rows or highlighting one cell
avoid: resizing one cell: Width and Height are read-only here; use ITableColumn.SetWidth / ITableRow.SetHeight
styling many cells: use an ITableCellRange (ApplyFill, Borders) instead of looping

cards.name: ITableCellRange
cards.summary: A set of table cells handled together: merge or unmerge them, apply one fill, style their borders, select them, grow the set by cell, row, column or another range and shrink it by index, cell or range (there is no RemoveRow / RemoveColumn). Also tells whether the cells form a rectangle and can be merged.
use_for: merging a header row across all columns
zebra-striping rows or colouring a whole column at once
applying one border style to a block of cells
avoid: setting text per cell: loop the range's Item cells (ITableCell.TextShape)
cards.how: Returned by ITableShape.CellRange(ColumnStart, RowStart, ColumnEnd, RowEnd), ITableShape.Selection, ITableCells.All / Range / AllExcluding, or built from ITableShape.CreateEmptyCellRange plus AddCell / AddRow / AddColumn.

key_members.name: Columns
key_members.use: columns touched by the range

key_members.name: Select
key_members.use: select the cells in the document

gotchas: Check CanMerge (and IsRectangular) before Merge; merging a non-rectangular set is refused (unverified whether it raises or does nothing).
ApplyFill needs an IVGFill object, not a colour: take the Fill of an existing shape or cell as the source.
Selection reflects the cells selected in the UI; it can be empty in a script that never selected anything.
cards.example:
Set t = ActiveShape.Custom             ' a table
Set hdr = t.CellRange(1, 1, t.Columns.Count, 1)
If hdr.CanMerge Then hdr.Merge
Set zebra = t.CreateEmptyCellRange()
zebra.AddRow t.Rows.Item(2)
zebra.ApplyFill t.Cell(1, 1).Fill

review.changes: summary claimed the range shrinks by row / column; only Remove(Index), RemoveCell and RemoveRange exist

cards.name: ITableCells
cards.summary: A collection of table cells (all cells of a table, a row, a column or a set of rows / columns) with indexed access and helpers that turn the whole collection, chosen indexes, or everything except chosen indexes into a cell range.
use_for: looping every cell to fill a table from a CSV
styling all cells except a header block in one call via AllExcluding
avoid: addressing a cell by row and column: ITableShape.Cell(Column, Row) is clearer than a flat index
cards.how: Returned by ITableShape.Cells, ITableRow.Cells, ITableColumn.Cells, ITableRows.Cells and ITableColumns.Cells.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of cells

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: cell at a flat Index

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: enumerator behind For Each

key_members.name: All
key_members.use: every cell as an ITableCellRange

key_members.name: Range
key_members.use: the cells at the given indexes as an ITableCellRange

key_members.name: AllExcluding
key_members.use: every cell except the given indexes as an ITableCellRange

gotchas: Range and AllExcluding take an array of indexes (SAFEARRAY of Variant); from Python pass a list, from VBA Array(1, 2, 3).
The order of the flat index (row by row or column by column) is not harvested (unverified); read RowIndex / ColumnIndex of each cell when it matters.
Base of Item indexes is not harvested; VGCore collections are 1-based (unverified for this component).
cards.example:
Set t = ActiveShape.Custom             ' a table
For Each c In t.Cells
  c.SetAllMargins 0.04
Next
Set body = t.Cells.AllExcluding(Array(1, 2, 3))
body.ApplyFill t.Cell(1, 2).Fill

cards.name: ITableShape
cards.summary: A CorelDRAW table object (Table/Create New Table): rows, columns and cells, table borders, cell spacing and separated / collapsed borders, the current cell selection, and methods to add rows and columns, address a cell or a block of cells, and convert the table to text.
use_for: price lists, menus, timetables and spec sheets filled from data
invoice or certificate templates with a grid of fields
turning a table back into delimited text (ConvertToText, or Table/Convert Table to Text)
avoid: page layout grids: guides or PowerClip frames are lighter than a table
text that only needs tab alignment: paragraph text with tab stops
cards.how: A table is a VGCore custom shape: Shape.Custom on the table shape (Shape.Type = cdrCustomShape, 21) returns this interface (TypeID identifies it). New tables come from Layer.CreateCustomShape with the table's TypeID and its parameters (exact parameter list not harvested), or from the Table/Create New Table menu. Cells are addressed Cell(Column, Row).

key_members.use: custom shape type of the table (check before casting)

key_members.use: insert a row; RowIndex is optional and defaults to 0; returns the new ITableRow

key_members.name: AddColumn
key_members.use: insert a column; ColumnIndex is optional and defaults to 0; returns the new ITableColumn

key_members.name: SeparatedBorders
key_members.use: separated (True) or collapsed (False) cell borders

key_members.name: SetCellSpacing
key_members.use: horizontal and vertical spacing between cells

key_members.use: horizontal cell spacing

key_members.name: CellSpacingY
key_members.use: vertical cell spacing

key_members.name: Selection
key_members.use: cells currently selected

key_members.name: CreateEmptyCellRange
key_members.use: empty range to build up with AddCell / AddRow

key_members.name: ConvertToText
key_members.use: convert the table to delimited text; DeleteTable defaults to True, so the table is removed unless you pass False

key_members.name: ClearSelection
key_members.use: deselect all cells

key_members.name: Delete
key_members.use: delete the table

gotchas: Cell and CellRange take the column before the row.
The TypeID string a table reports and the parameter list CreateCustomShape expects for it are not harvested; read TypeID from an existing table and test creation once (unverified).
Shape.Custom is typed IVGCustomShape; late-bound callers can call table members directly, early-bound code needs a cast (unverified).
Sizes and spacing are in document units (unverified for the table component); set ActiveDocument.Unit before writing numbers.

ConvertToText's DeleteTable defaults to True: a call with no arguments removes the table and invalidates its cell references; pass DeleteTable:=False to keep it. The default separators (ColumnSeparator / RowSeparator are optional Variants) are not harvested.

AddRow / AddColumn default their index to 0; where 0 puts the new row or column, and whether a positive index inserts before or after it, is not harvested (unverified); check Rows.Count / Columns.Count after the call.
cards.example:
Set s = ActiveShape                    ' a table made with Table/Create New Table
Set t = s.Custom
Debug.Print t.TypeID, t.Columns.Count, t.Rows.Count
t.Cell(1, 1).TextShape.Text.Story.Text = "Item"
Set r = t.AddRow()                ' RowIndex defaults to 0
t.Columns.DistributeWidth

review.changes: added the harvested defaults the card missed: ConvertToText DeleteTable = True (a bare call deletes the table), AddRow / AddColumn index = 0; example no longer passes an index past the last row; 'tab-separated' (separator defaults not harvested) -> delimited; named cdrCustomShape (21)
